beats.say: Official documents travel only through official channels: work email or the document management system.
Personal messengers and personal email are outside the institution's control. A document there can get lost or leak.
Read the recipient before you send. Autocomplete can pick a similar name that belongs to someone else.
When in doubt, do not send, ask. If a document went to the wrong place, report it at once.

scenes.prompt: Find the mistakes in this email before it is sent.

body.text: Text: If the file does not open,

spots.label: Personal email address
spots.explain: Official documents go to a work address or the document system. Personal email is outside the institution's control.

spots.label: Copy to everyone
spots.explain: Not all 212 people need this file. Choose only those who do.

spots.label: Citizens' ID numbers
spots.explain: A file with personal data goes only to whoever works with it, ideally staying in the system.

spots.label: Password in the same email
spots.explain: Sending the password with the file cancels the protection. Give the password through another channel.

scenes.title: Out of the office
scenes.intro: You are out of the office and work messages arrive. Choose the right step for each.

body.text: Hi, I am out of the office. Send the draft order to my WhatsApp, I will look at it here.

actions.label: Send the file on WhatsApp
actions.feedback: In a personal messenger the document leaves the institution's control. Managers have an official channel too.

actions.label: I will send it in SənədAxını
actions.feedback: Right. The document stays in the official system and your manager can open it there.

body.text: Is your new order out? Send me a photo, I will not tell anyone.

actions.label: You will see it on the website once published
actions.feedback: Right. An unpublished document does not leave the institution.

actions.label: Take a photo and send it
actions.feedback: The photo is no longer under your control. It can be spread anywhere.

steps.label: You meant to write to your colleague Aysel Məmmədova
steps.say: Look carefully at the recipient's address.

actions.label: Tell your manager and the security team
actions.feedback: Right. Reporting fast buys time to limit the damage.

actions.label: Nobody will notice, forget it
actions.feedback: The file is at an outside address. Hiding it makes the damage worse, reporting protects.

question.prompt: How can you take an official document home to work on it?

options.label: I email it to my personal address
options.feedback: Personal email is outside the institution's control. The document stays there and can leak.

options.label: I copy it to my own USB stick
options.feedback: USB sticks are easily lost. Do not carry official documents without your institution's permission.

options.label: The way the institution allows: work laptop or VPN
options.feedback: Right. The approved route protects the document and keeps it under control.

scenes.explain: Working from home follows the institution's rules. If there is no approved route, the document stays in the office.

nodes.text: You sent a confidential report to the shared printer in the corridor. Right then your phone rings.

choices.label: I take the call and go to the printer later
choices.feedback: The paper sits in the printer and anyone passing by can see it.

choices.label: I collect the paper first
choices.feedback: Right. If the printer offers PIN release printing, use it.

nodes.text: Someone else's labelled document is also left in the printer.

choices.label: I read it to find out whose it is
choices.feedback: There is no need to read it. Hand it to the security team or the head of department.

choices.label: I throw it in the bin
choices.feedback: Paper is easy to take from an ordinary bin. Labelled paper is destroyed in a shredder.

choices.label: I hand it, unread, to the security team
choices.feedback: Right. The document returns to its owner and nobody reads it.

points: Official documents go through official channels, not personal messengers or email.
Check the recipient and attachment before sending, report mistakes at once.
Do not leave labelled paper in the printer or throw it in an ordinary bin.
